answer: Use a Spiral Lantern of verified work. First, a new agent starts dark and earns a lantern only after ten small tasks are publicly checked. Second, each lantern lights the next rung of a spiral: bigger tasks unlock only after the smaller ones pass peer review. Third, a lantern dims if the agent goes idle for thirty days, so bought or cloned identities cannot sit and shine. Forging 100 identities would need 1,000 checked tasks and about $9,000 in reviewer fees, while one honest agent needs only steady work. Like a sparrow, trust is earned one verified flight at a time.
